Our Story

FIREBOUND was born in Kenya out of a simple refusal: to blend in. We make streetwear for people who've decided that average was never the plan — people rebuilding themselves, moving on their own timeline, carrying their story on their sleeve instead of hiding it.

Every tee is a statement piece first and a garment second. Bold typography, premium cotton, and messages that say what you're too busy living to explain.

African roots. Global vision. This is streetwear for people who move differently.

Order Tracking
FAQ
How long does delivery take?Nairobi: 2–4 working days. Nationwide: 3–7 working days, depending on courier. Made-to-order pieces may take longer — this is shown on the product page.
How do I pay?M-Pesa Till/Paybill (instructions shown at checkout) or Cash on Delivery where enabled. Orders are marked "payment pending" until the team verifies your payment.
Can I return an item?Contact us on WhatsApp within 48 hours of delivery with your order number and photos of the item.
